note: Probability and impact columns are analyst assessments, not sourced statistics. The basis column links the factual anchor for each risk.

risks.event: Tenant bankruptcy, franchisee default or lease rejection
risks.exposure: Rent stops if the operator fails, even in a NNN lease. NNN protects against expenses, not against vacancy.
risks.mitigation: Obtain lease + guarantor; require corporate guaranty or letter of credit on renewal; monitor JACK same-store sales and closures quarterly.
risks.indicator: JACK same-store sales, closure count, credit rating, franchisee distress disclosures in 10-Q/10-K.
risks.basis: Jack in the Box Inc., Q4/FY2025 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1 (SEC)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Expiry risk: value decays as remaining term shortens
risks.exposure: Buyers of single-tenant NNN assets need long remaining term to finance; with 1-5 years left the buyer pool collapses to land buyers.
risks.mitigation: Decide before the term premium is gone. Market the asset while 5+ years remain if exit is chosen.
risks.indicator: Remaining term, comparable NNN marketing times, lender appetite.
risks.basis: Jack in the Box Inc., Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC accession 0000807882-25-000072)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Rent exceeds the unit's economic capacity at renewal
risks.exposure: Franchise margins are compressing (Q4 franchise-level margin 38.9% from 40.4%); a rent reset upward is not available if sales are falling.
risks.mitigation: Model renewal at flat-to-modest growth; do not underwrite market rent growth above CPI.
risks.indicator: Franchise-level margin, same-store sales, commodity inflation.
risks.basis: Jack in the Box Inc., Q4/FY2025 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1 (SEC)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Measure ULA transfer tax on a City of Los Angeles sale above $5m
risks.exposure: 4.0% of the full sale price (5.5% above $10m), paid by the seller, on top of documentary transfer taxes.
risks.mitigation: Size the exit cost into the sale decision now; evaluate structured/installment sale; if timing is flexible, transact when pricing offsets the tax.
risks.indicator: City of Los Angeles ordinance and annual indexed thresholds.
risks.basis: City of Los Angeles City Attorney — Measure ULA
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.exposure: A buyer's property tax resets at sale. In a NNN lease the tenant bears it, so the reset hits the tenant's occupancy cost and thus renewal capacity.
risks.mitigation: Quantify the assessed-value step before marketing; show buyers a post-sale tax estimate to avoid price churn.
risks.indicator: Assessor assessed value and Prop 13/Prop 8 mechanics.
risks.basis: Los Angeles County Assessor, Decline-in-Value / Proposition 8
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Further statutory wage increases for fast-food workers
risks.exposure: $20/hour already applies (AB 1228). Any further Council increase hits store-level margin, which is the tenant's ability to pay rent.
risks.mitigation: Stress-test tenant coverage at +5% and +10% labour cost.
risks.basis: California Dept. of Industrial Relations, AB 1228 Fast Food Council
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Continued population and employment stagnation in LA County
risks.exposure: DOF projects county population -1.5% by 2035; total nonfarm payrolls +0.5% y/y with Information -5.7%.
risks.mitigation: Do not underwrite volume growth; treat growth as rent-escalation only.
risks.basis: California Dept. of Finance, Report P-2A County Population Projections (Baseline 2024, Vintage 2026)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Cap-rate expansion from a higher-for-longer rate environment
risks.exposure: 10-year Treasury at 4.90% (2026-11-04); every 50 bp of cap-rate expansion removes ~8% of value at a 6.0% cap.
risks.mitigation: Refinance analysis before sale; consider holding through a rate peak only if cash flow covers carry.
risks.basis: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity (DGS10)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.exposure: Energy CPI +20.3% y/y and gasoline +30.8% (Sept 2026). NNN passes cost to tenant, which further pressures rent capacity.
risks.mitigation: Confirm recovery mechanics and caps in the lease; review the CAM/utility reconciliation.
risks.basis: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPI Los Angeles area, Sept 2026 (26-1595-SAN)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Carrier withdrawal or premium shock (wildfire-concentrated market)
risks.exposure: FAIR Plan is the insurer of last resort; commercial limit $20m/location. Premium rises hit the tenant's NNN cost load.
risks.mitigation: Obtain a current declaration page and a broker quote for the renewal year; consider a lender-required insurance covenant.
risks.indicator: California Department of Insurance FAIR Plan data.
risks.basis: California Department of Insurance, FAIR Plan modernisation (release 031-2024)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: M6.7-M7.8 rupture causing structural damage or total loss
risks.exposure: USGS ShakeOut: ~1,800 deaths and $213bn regional losses. Unreinforced masonry or soft-story buildings are the exposure.
risks.mitigation: Seismic retrofit assessment; confirm earthquake cover and deductibles; keep a repair reserve.
risks.basis: U.S. Geological Survey, The ShakeOut Scenario (M7.8)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Regional wildfire destroying utility, insurance and consumer demand even if the parcel is untouched
risks.exposure: Palisades Fire: 23,448 acres, 6,845 structures destroyed, 12 deaths (Jan 2025). Second-order effects: insurance repricing, utility cost, tourism.
risks.mitigation: Parcel-level FHSZ lookup; defensible-space and roof class review; insurance adequacy test.
risks.indicator: CAL FIRE incident record; OSFM FHSZ.
risks.basis: CAL FIRE incident record, Palisades Fire (LA-69 Bravo)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Civil unrest, curfew or prolonged disruption in the trade area
risks.exposure: Store closure during unrest produces zero sales while rent continues; uninsured loss possible.
risks.mitigation: Verify business-interruption and civil-commotion cover; maintain tenant communication plan.
risks.indicator: None located for a forward-looking probability. Treated as judgement only.
risks.basis: California Department of Insurance, FAIR Plan modernisation (release 031-2024)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: New or expanded local transfer/“mansion” taxes or rent regulation
risks.exposure: LA has already imposed a 4%/5.5% transfer tax. Further levies raise exit friction for the next buyer and lower bids today.
risks.mitigation: Model a +2% adverse exit-cost sensitivity; retain timing flexibility.
risks.indicator: City of Los Angeles ordinance record.
risks.basis: City of Los Angeles City Attorney — Measure ULA
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Wealth concentrated in one parcel, one tenant, one seismic zone
risks.exposure: A single-asset, single-tenant position has no diversification: one vacancy or one event dominates the owner's net worth.
risks.mitigation: Set a maximum share of net worth in this asset; plan a 1031 or DST diversification on exit.
risks.basis: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity (DGS10)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability

risks.event: Decision made on incomplete property data (lease, APN, insurance)
risks.exposure: Fifteen property-level fields are unverified in this build. Every valuation line inherits that uncertainty.
risks.mitigation: Close the U-01 to U-11 information gaps before signing anything.
risks.basis: Jack in the Box Inc., Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC accession 0000807882-25-000072)
risks.probability_basis: Analyst assessment — not a sourced statistical probability
